definitions.title: Any OpenAI-compatible server
definitions.example: For example, vLLM, llama.cpp or LM Studio
definitions.summary: Chat, embeddings, reranking, speech, transcription and images. Azizam finds out which of these the server offers.

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Where the server listens, with its port. Usually ends in /v1.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Leave empty if the server has no key.

fields.label: Environment variable name
fields.help: Azizam reads the key from this variable on the gateway’s computer. Only the name is saved. The value is never shown.

fields.label: Request headers
fields.help: Extra headers Azizam sends with every request to this server, for example X-Client: azizam-home.

fields.label: Time to wait for a reply
fields.help: Raise this for slow models.

fields.label: Extra path before every request
fields.help: Leave empty unless the server needs one, for example /openai. Azizam puts it between the address and each route.

fields.label: Key header name
fields.help: The header that carries the key. Most servers use Authorization. Some use X-API-Key.

fields.label: Request adjustments
fields.help: Fix a mismatch between what apps send and what this server accepts, for example leave out a field the server refuses. Each one says in plain words what it does.

fields.label: Who starts and stops this server
Start command
fields.help: Run on the gateway’s computer when a request needs this server.

fields.label: Wait for it to be ready
Stop when idle for
fields.help: 0 means never.

definitions.title: Node-graph image and video server
definitions.summary: Runs a workflow file. You pick the file and say which inputs it takes.

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Where the server listens, with its port. Usually port 8188. Do not add /v1.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Leave empty if the server has no key.

fields.label: Environment variable name
fields.help: Azizam reads the key from this variable on the gateway’s computer. Only the name is saved. The value is never shown.

fields.label: Workflow file
fields.help: A .json file in API format, up to 20 MB.

fields.label: Name apps use
fields.help: Apps ask for this workflow by this name, for example “sdxl-text-to-image”.

fields.label: Time to wait for a reply
fields.help: Pictures and video take longer than text.

fields.label: Who starts and stops this server
Wait for it to be ready

workflow_inputs.label: Prompt
workflow_inputs.help: The words an app sends, for example “a red bicycle”.
workflow_inputs.matched_note: Matched on its own: node {node}, “{title}”, feeds the sampler’s positive input.

workflow_inputs.label: Image in
workflow_inputs.help: A picture an app sends to edit or to start from.
workflow_inputs.missing_note: This file has no node that loads an image, so image-in stays off.

workflow_inputs.label: Seed
workflow_inputs.help: Azizam sends a new random number each time, unless an app sets one.

workflow_inputs.label: Steps
workflow_inputs.help: How long the server refines the picture. Left unused, the file’s own value stays.

workflow_inputs.label: Model
workflow_inputs.help: Which model file the server loads, for example “sd_xl_base_1.0”.

definitions.title: Speech-to-text server with a custom path
definitions.summary: Turns audio into text at a path you give.

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Where the server listens, with its port. Leave the path out. It goes in the next field.

fields.label: Path on the server
fields.help: The part after the address that accepts audio, starting with /. For example /inference. Ask whoever set up the server if you are not sure.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Leave empty if the server has no key.

fields.label: Environment variable name
fields.help: Azizam reads the key from this variable on the gateway’s computer. Only the name is saved. The value is never shown.

fields.label: Public name
fields.help: The name apps use to pick this model, for example “whisper”.

fields.label: Name the server uses (optional)
fields.help: Sent as the model name with every request. Leave it empty if the server has one model and ignores the name.

fields.label: Time to wait for a reply
Who starts and stops this server
Wait for it to be ready

definitions.title: Text-to-speech server with a custom path

fields.label: Address

fields.label: Path on the server
fields.help: The part after the address that accepts text, starting with /. For example /api/tts. Ask whoever set up the server if you are not sure.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Leave empty if the server has no key.

fields.label: Environment variable name
fields.help: Azizam reads the key from this variable on the gateway’s computer. Only the name is saved. The value is never shown.

fields.label: Public name
fields.help: The name apps use to pick this model, for example “local-voice”.

fields.label: Name the server uses (optional)
fields.help: Sent as the model name with every request. Leave it empty if the server has one model and ignores the name.

fields.label: Voices
fields.help: Apps pick a voice by this name, for example “en_US-lessac-medium”. This kind of server does not list its voices, so type each one.

findings.title: Server not reachable
findings.what: Azizam could not reach the server.
findings.why: Nothing answered at 192.168.1.50:8080 within 5 seconds. The server may be off, or the address or port may be wrong.
findings.fix: Check that the server is running and that the address and port are right. If Azizam runs in a container, “localhost” means the container, not your computer. If Azizam should start this server itself, add it kept off, then set its start command on the engine page.

findings.title: Server not reachable

findings.why: Nothing answered at 192.168.1.50:8080 within 5 seconds. The server may be off, or the address or port may be wrong.
findings.fix: Check that the server is running and that the address and port are right. If Azizam runs in a container, “localhost” means the container, not your computer. If the server starts only when needed, add it kept off and ask the owner to set its start command.

findings.title: No model list at this address

findings.why: The server returned “404 Not Found” for /models, the same as for a made-up path. The API probably starts one level deeper.
findings.fix: Add /v1 to the end of the address, then check again.

finding.title: This file is not in API format
finding.what: Azizam read “dream-v2.json”, but it only holds the picture of the graph: where the boxes sit and what colour they are.
finding.why: The editor saves two kinds of file. The server runs only the API kind, which lists each step and its settings.
finding.fix: In the editor, choose “Export (API)”, then pick that new file here.
